description: Tell whether a page changed since the last time you read it. Has a page changed since you last read it? Send a URL and the content_sha256 you kept from a previous call; get back changed: true or false, the current checksum and the current length. Without a checksum, returns the starting point. Main content only, navigation stripped. Body: {url, since_sha256?}. — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "what changed on this page since yesterday", "tell me whether this page changed", "diff this page against its previous version".
name: web_changed
